page: Microsoft Azure NC16ads_A10_v4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine from the NCADSA10v4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD x86_64 processor. The instance is equipped with 200.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.5 GB per vCPU.

For accelerated workloads, the server includes a single NVIDIA A10 GPU with 22 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage consists of a 1475 GB SSD, and the instance is premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the integration of dedicated AMD cores, a mid-range NVIDIA A10 GPU, and substantial local SSD storage, this configuration offers a resource-dense profile for specialized workloads. It is designed for GPU-intensive applications, deep learning inference, data science workflows, and database systems requiring local high-speed scratch space alongside significant memory capacity.
